positions.name: OwnedVsRentedDistinction
positions.frame: what distinguishes intelligence you own from intelligence you rent, and where does the durable value sit?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: a categorical contrast between owned and rented intelligence, enacted through antithesis and market-pricing relational framing. src-2 states the distinction plainly; src-3 locates the retained value in perspective rather than substrate. They share autonomy valuation, present-realis abstract temporality, and claim-level conviction without escalation to decision or principle.

positions.name: PositioningNoteSelfReference
positions.frame: what is this document for, and how does it announce its own function to a navigating extractor?
positions.why: Both expressions are metacommentary describing the document's own purpose: src-1 identifies it as a positioning note for a regression guard, and src-4 explains it restates a thesis so an extractor has existing positioning to connect to. They share a flat, matter-of-fact register and claim-level conviction, performing self-referential framing rather than substantive claims about intelligence.
